 PRESS RELEASE 
Publication of the indicative calendar of reserve maintenance periods for 2007
 28 July 2006 
The European Central Bank (ECB) is today publishing the indicative calendar of reserve maintenance periods for 2007.
Taking into account the 2007 schedule for the meetings of the Governing Council of the ECB (see the ECB press release of 2 June 2006) and the indicative calendar for the Eurosystem’s tender operations in 2007 (see the ECB press release published today), the indicative calendar of reserve maintenance periods for 2007 is as follows: 
 Indicative calyendar of maintenance periods for 2007 
 MP | 
 Relevant Governing Council meeting |

 End of maintenance period | 
 Reserve base data for credit institutions reporting monthly |
